en: The postcard's front image depicts a public square with a large fountain at the center, surrounded by trees and ornate street lamps. In the background is a grand building with the signage 'Sundsvalls Enskilda Bank' at the top. The back of the postcard has handwritten text, a green Swedish postage stamp (10 öre, with a lion), and address lines indicating it was sent to Stockholm. The layout and style are typical of early 20th-century European postcards.
